reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the Complex has citrate in it, which gives me cramps, so that one is out; the plain bisglycinate is the only one I would look at. But it has zero reviews and I do not buy a new supplement without reading what other people say, and $1 a day is more than I pay per serving now.
objection: No reviews at all, and a dollar a day when I can get bisglycinate for much less from brands with thousands of reviews. A QR code lab report is nice but I cannot tell if the brand is real.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen verified reviews from people with sensitive stomachs, or a price near $19.99 for the bisglycinate so a first box feels like a low-risk trial.
